Public indexed professional profiles, self-published posts and company announcements used. No authenticated private access. Indexing can lag; fetching a source is not employment or purchasing verification.

limitations: Companies are research profiles for brands/businesses, not a verified count of independent legal buying entities.
General business routes and named person emails are separate. No email addresses or phone numbers were guessed.
Directory-only titles remain explicitly unverified. Hiring posts were used for context, never to turn HR/recruiters into purchasing managers.
Conflicting current employers, liked/reposted third-party roles, private/masked contact data and unsupported ingredient claims were excluded.
Partial brand descriptions and marketplace evidence need complete current label review. New profiles retain Needs review; no purchasing demand or quantity is inferred.
Research dates show when sources were inspected; they are not role-confirmation dates.
Business routes deduplicated within each company across spaces and Indian country-code formatting; the same shared company route can serve multiple brands.

Shipping-weight audit corrected five new product weights: three use explicit title/variant weights; two remain unknown. Source check dates are preserved separately from research correction timestamps.
